requested_changes.title: Revise Ritual Reel caption and Page Turn Loop hook
requested_changes.summary: Caption and hook rewrites require editorial judgment. Mark as manual completion unless exact replacement copy is supplied.
requested_changes.full_instruction: Rewrite the page_turn_loop hook and the ritual_reel caption before publishing either piece. 'This is what your afternoon could feel like' is conditional and generic — it must be replaced with a line that names the specific feeling rather than promising one. The ritual_reel caption's opening paragraph ('Oh Betty Jaletti is a literary lifestyle brand built around that hour') is founder-update voice and must be cut; the caption should open on the ritual itself ('A book you've been saving. A drink that's just right.') and let the brand name appear only in the closing CTA line. The Pinterest caption keyword dump must be replaced entirely — it will attract the wrong audience and is directly contrary to brand voice.
